summary: Grupo Televisa filed a 6-K furnishing a September 18, 2026 press release responding to unusual trading volume in its CPOs. At the request of Mexico's CNBV under Article 106 of the Securities Market Law, Televisa stated it is unaware of any cause for the movement, attributing it possibly to market conditions, and confirmed no Board member or Relevant Officer traded CPOs and no repurchase-program activity occurred. The filing is a routine market-conditions disclosure, not a special situation; no stake, price, or board recommendation is involved. Watch for any follow-up disclosure if an exhaustive review identifies additional information.
